## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance episode from VG about fund costs. It argues that fees are the one part of returns an investor controls, and that the same fund can cost very different amounts depending on the platform: DNB Global Index costs about 0.2% at the cheapest banks and up to 0.61% at small SpareBank 1 regional banks, and DNB Teknologi costs 1.03% at Pareto against 1.58% at Nordea. The second half explains ETFs versus ordinary mutual funds (cost structure, currency markups, spreads, the wide selection of niche ETFs, distributing versus accumulating funds, physical versus synthetic replication). No stock calls are made; the general mood is neutral-to-positive education about saving money on fees.
